headline: Rina from the Weekend Table wants to feature your focaccia and needs a yes today, and Dana is baking your sourdough for Saturday.

waiting.said: Hi @mayabakes! I edit the Weekend Table food page. Could we feature your rosemary focaccia this Sunday? I need a yes by end of day to make the print deadline.
waiting.gist: Wants to feature your focaccia this Sunday, needs a yes today
waiting.reply: Hi Rina, I would love that! Yes from me. [Do you need photos from me, or will you shoot it?]

waiting.said: @mayabakes does this work with whole wheat flour? Baking it for my mum on Saturday and I only have whole wheat at home 🙈

about.text: My weekend sourdough, the slow way: flour, water, salt, and one night in the fridge. Full recipe in the thread 🧵

waiting.gist: Asks if your sourdough works with whole wheat flour, for Saturday
waiting.reply: Yes! Use a little more water and give it an extra hour to rise. [Want me to send the exact amounts?] Happy birthday to your mum!

waiting.said: This thread is the best thing on my timeline this week. @mayabakes will you ever do a gluten free version? Asking for half my family.

about.text: My weekend sourdough, the slow way: flour, water, salt, and one night in the fridge. Full recipe in the thread 🧵

waiting.gist: Quoted your sourdough thread and asks for a gluten free version
waiting.reply: Thank you Omer! A gluten free loaf is on my list. [Say when you plan to try it?]

waiting.said: @mayabakes small thing: the recipe link in your bio goes to a page that says not found

about.text: New recipes every Friday. The full list is in my bio 🥖

waiting.gist: Tells you the recipe link in your bio is broken
waiting.reply: Thank you for telling me, Lior! Fixing it now.

waiting.said: @mayabakes @danalevi are you both coming to the bread swap at the market on Sunday? We need someone to bring a starter for the newcomers
waiting.gist: Asks if you are coming to the bread swap on Sunday and can bring a starter
waiting.reply: I will be there! [Can I bring a starter for the newcomers?]
